final: WITH matching_records AS (SELECT DISTINCT sp.arcref, p.fundflux FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry), counts_by_source AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as project_count FROM matching_records GROUP BY fundflux), stats AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(project_count AS FLOAT)) as avg_count FROM counts_by_source) SELECT cbs.fundflux, cbs.project_count, CAST(cbs.project_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(project_count) FROM counts_by_source) as share, cbs.project_count - s.avg_count as exceeds_average FROM counts_by_source cbs CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE cbs.project_count > s.avg_count ORDER BY cbs.project_count DESC
